elements.title: 1. The TODO list starts empty - no confirmation is outstanding
3. ReservationPlaced - this OPENS the TODO item
4. The task is now on the list - one row, one confirmation owed
5. The background process reads the list and picks the row up
6. It issues SendReservationConfirmation for that row
7. ReservationConfirmationSent - this CLOSES the TODO item
8. The row is gone. The list is empty again - so the process has nothing left to act on and the confirmation cannot be sent a second time
